title: Two ledgers
dek: Why a CTSO is posting constraint algebras. Same temperament, different success test.
text:
Some days I’m deep in AI, cybersecurity, advisor technology, compliance guardrails… and occasionally wandering into math, geometry, physics, and whatever strange rabbit hole the universe decides to open next. But my day job is still pretty simple: Help protect advisors, help protect clients, and help make technology actually useful in a highly regulated, trust-based business.

One paragraph is enough. Full career chronology, cleverDome corporate history, and award copy stay off this wiki. Day-job interviews live on Public voice. Research field notes live on the spine.
